scientific_integrity: Proof gives infinite-family implication via cyclic deficit budget and edge subdivision; finite enumeration through order 22 is independent corroboration, not the basis of the infinite result. Mathematical priority remains qualified and independent audit is not performed.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns minimum-cardinality dominating sets of simple cycles, not all dominating sets or inclusion-minimal sets. It determines vertex-membership VC shattering, not Littlestone dimensions or trace multiplicities. Earlier papers fully classified the minimum dominating sets. Unindexed equivalent Boolean-trace results remain possible.
title: Minimum domination on cycles: the full three-residue shattering law
